prompt: Which Schengen Area country implemented the Schengen Agreement the soonest after signing it?
answer: **Spain and Portugal, jointly.** They signed/acceded to the Schengen arrangements in **June 1991**, and implemented them when internal border checks were abolished on **26 March 1995**—about **three years and nine months later**, the shortest interval among the participating countries.
